title: OLX.ba Market Overview
description: Direct views of current listings, recorded price changes, scrape runs, and observed closures in the lean schema. Historical charts use retained event timestamps rather than reconstructed daily inventory.

filters.label: Category

filters.label: Rooms

panels.title: Active listings
panels.description: Listings on OLX now.
panels.sql:
WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal} = 'All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR COALESCE(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), coverage AS (SELECT (min(started_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AS start FROM lean.scrape_runs), fresh AS (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE (l.first_seen > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND l.first_seen <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date)) AS new_n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE (l.first_seen > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - ((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AND l.first_seen <= (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date)) AS new_prev FROM lean.listings l WHERE ((${deal} = 'All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), exits AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal} = 'All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category} = 'All' OR e.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (e.occurred_at > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND e.occurred_at <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date)) SELECT count(*) AS active, (SELECT new_n FROM fresh) AS new_n, CASE WHEN (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - ((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) >= (SELECT start FROM coverage) THEN (SELECT new_prev FROM fresh) END AS new_prev,
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) FILTER (WHERE deal='sale' AND ppm2>0)::numeric,0) AS median_sale_ppm2,
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) FILTER (WHERE deal='rent' AND price>0)::numeric,0) AS median_rent,
  round(count(*)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT n FROM exits) * 30.0 / NULLIF(((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - GREATEST((${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date, (SELECT start FROM coverage))), 0), 0), 1) AS months_of_inventory
FROM base

panels.title: Price cuts
panels.description: Active listings with a recorded price cut in the selected time window, compared with the window before it.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal} = 'All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR COALESCE(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), coverage AS (SELECT (min(started_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AS start FROM lean.scrape_runs), prices AS (SELECT ph.article_id, ph.price_date, ph.price, lag(ph.price) OVER (PARTITION BY ph.article_id ORDER BY ph.price_date, ph.id) AS previous_price FROM lean.price_history ph JOIN base USING (article_id) WHERE ph.price IS NOT NULL AND ph.source='api_price_history'), cuts AS (SELECT article_id, price_date, previous_price, price, 100.0*(previous_price-price)/previous_price AS cut_pct FROM prices WHERE previous_price > price) SELECT count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE (price_date > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND price_date <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date)) AS drops, CASE WHEN (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - ((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) >= (SELECT start FROM coverage) THEN count(DISTINCT article_id) FILTER (WHERE (price_date > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - ((${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AND price_date <= (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date)) END AS drops_prev, round(100.0*count(DISTINCT article_id)/NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM base),0),0) AS cut_share_pct, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cut_pct) FILTER (WHERE (price_date > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND price_date <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date))::numeric,1) AS median_cut_pct FROM cuts

panels.title: Sale asking price per m² · daily
panels.description: Median and interquartile range across sale listings that match the filters and were active at each day's end. Each listing carries its latest reported price; historical KM/m² uses current area. Days before collection began only include listings still active when it did. Listings without a reported price history carry their current ask from the day they were first seen.
panels.sql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT date(${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo') AS start_day,
         LEAST(date(${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'), (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AS end_day
), sale_listings AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT l.article_id, l.sqm, l.price, l.first_seen
  FROM lean.listings l
  WHERE l.deal = 'sale' AND l.sqm > 0
    AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)
), openings AS (
  SELECT article_id, first_seen AS opened_at FROM sale_listings
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.article_id, e.occurred_at AS opened_at
  FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e
  JOIN sale_listings s USING (article_id)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'reopened'
), cycles AS (
  SELECT o.article_id, o.opened_at, c.closed_at
  FROM openings o
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT min(e.occurred_at) AS closed_at
    FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e
    WHERE e.article_id = o.article_id
      AND e.event_type = 'closed'
      AND e.occurred_at > o.opened_at
  ) c ON TRUE
), prior_prices AS (
  SELECT s.article_id, price.price, price.price_date
  FROM sale_listings s
  CROSS JOIN bounds
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ph.price, ph.price_date
    FROM lean.price_history ph
    WHERE ph.article_id = s.article_id
      AND ph.source = 'api_price_history'
      AND ph.price > 0
      AND ph.price_date < bounds.start_day
    ORDER BY ph.price_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) price
), window_prices AS (
  SELECT s.article_id, price.price, price.price_date
  FROM sale_listings s
  CROSS JOIN bounds
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ph.price, ph.price_date
    FROM lean.price_history ph
    WHERE ph.article_id = s.article_id
      AND ph.source = 'api_price_history'
      AND ph.price > 0
      AND ph.price_date BETWEEN bounds.start_day AND bounds.end_day
  ) price
), price_spans AS (
  SELECT relevant.article_id, relevant.price, relevant.price_date,
         lead(relevant.price_date) OVER (
           PARTITION BY relevant.article_id ORDER BY relevant.price_date
         ) AS next_date
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM prior_prices
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM window_prices
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.article_id, s.price, s.first_seen
    FROM sale_listings s
    WHERE s.price > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM lean.price_history ph
      WHERE ph.article_id = s.article_id AND ph.source = 'api_price_history' AND ph.price > 0
    )
  ) relevant
), daily AS (
  SELECT d.day::date AS day, p.price / NULLIF(l.sqm, 0) AS ppm2
  FROM price_spans p
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    GREATEST(p.price_date, b.start_day),
    LEAST(COALESCE(p.next_date - 1, b.end_day), b.end_day),
    INTERVAL '1 day'
  ) AS d(day) ON TRUE
  JOIN cycles c
    ON c.article_id = p.article_id
   AND c.opened_at < d.day::date + 1
   AND (c.closed_at IS NULL OR c.closed_at >= d.day::date + 1)
  JOIN sale_listings l ON l.article_id = c.article_id
)
SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time,
       percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) AS p25,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) AS median,
       percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) AS p75,
       count(*) AS listings
FROM daily GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Median KM/m² by rooms · sales
panels.description: The box spans the middle half, the whiskers the 10th–90th percentile. Click a box to filter the page.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal} = 'All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR COALESCE(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT coalesce(rooms,'unknown') AS rooms,count(*) AS listings,round(percentile_cont(0.1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)::numeric,0) AS p10,round(percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)::numeric,0) AS p25,round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)::numeric,0) AS median_ppm2,round(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)::numeric,0) AS p75,round(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)::numeric,0) AS p90 FROM base WHERE deal='sale' AND ppm2>0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Median KM/m² by floor · sales
panels.description: The box spans the middle half, the whiskers the 10th–90th percentile.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal} = 'All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR COALESCE(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT CASE WHEN floor_num IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN floor_num < 0 THEN 'basement' WHEN floor_num = 0 THEN 'ground' WHEN floor_num <= 2 THEN '1–2' WHEN floor_num <= 5 THEN '3–5' ELSE '6+' END AS floor_band,count(*) AS listings,round(percentile_cont(0.1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)::numeric,0) AS p10,round(percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)::numeric,0) AS p25,round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)::numeric,0) AS median_ppm2,round(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)::numeric,0) AS p75,round(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)::numeric,0) AS p90 FROM base WHERE deal='sale' AND ppm2>0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY min(floor_num) NULLS LAST

panels.title: Asking KM/m² vs area · sales
panels.description: Each dot is an active sale listing. Larger homes usually ask less per m², so low dots stand out as cheap for their size. Click a dot to open the ad.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal} = 'All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR COALESCE(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT sqm::float8 AS area,ppm2::float8 AS ppm2,neighborhood,title,url FROM base WHERE deal='sale' AND sqm>0 AND ppm2>0

panels.title: Median KM/m² by neighborhood and rooms · sales
panels.description: The 10 neighborhoods with the most sale listings. Cells with fewer than 3 listings stay blank. Click a cell to filter by its neighborhood.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal} = 'All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR COALESCE(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), ranked AS (SELECT neighborhood,row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) DESC, neighborhood) AS rank FROM base WHERE deal='sale' AND ppm2>0 AND neighborhood IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 LIMIT 10) SELECT b.neighborhood,coalesce(b.rooms,'unknown') AS rooms,count(*) AS listings,round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.ppm2)::numeric,0) AS median_ppm2 FROM base b JOIN ranked r USING (neighborhood) WHERE b.deal='sale' AND b.ppm2>0 GROUP BY 1,2,r.rank HAVING count(*) >= 3 ORDER BY r.rank, 2

panels.title: New and exited listings · weekly
panels.description: Listings first seen and listings that left OLX each week of the selected time window. An exit is not a confirmed sale.
panels.sql: WITH fresh AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', l.first_seen::timestamp) AS week, count(*) AS n FROM lean.listings l WHERE ((${deal} = 'All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (l.first_seen > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND l.first_seen <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) GROUP BY 1), gone AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', e.occurred_at::timestamp) AS week, count(*) AS n FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e WHERE e.event_type='closed' AND ((${deal} = 'All' AND e.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR e.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${category} = 'All' OR e.property_type = ${category}) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR coalesce(e.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR coalesce(e.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR e.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (e.occurred_at > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND e.occurred_at <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) GROUP BY 1) SELECT week AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time, coalesce(f.n,0) AS new_n, coalesce(g.n,0) AS closed_n FROM fresh f FULL JOIN gone g USING (week) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Median KM/m² by neighborhood · sales
panels.description: The 15 neighborhoods with the most sale listings. The box spans the middle half, the whiskers the 10th–90th percentile. Click a box to filter the page.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal} = 'All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR COALESCE(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT * FROM (SELECT coalesce(neighborhood,'unknown') AS neighborhood,count(*) AS listings,round(percentile_cont(0.1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)::numeric,0) AS p10,round(percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)::numeric,0) AS p25,round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)::numeric,0) AS median_ppm2,round(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)::numeric,0) AS p75,round(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2)::numeric,0) AS p90 FROM base WHERE deal='sale' AND ppm2>0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 15) top ORDER BY median_ppm2 DESC

panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal} = 'All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR COALESCE(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT property_type AS segment,count(*) AS listings,round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) FILTER (WHERE ppm2>0)::numeric,0) AS median_ppm2 FROM base WHERE deal='sale' AND property_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Best value · furthest below the neighborhood median
panels.description: Sale listings of at least 20 m² ranked by asking KM/m² against the median of their neighborhood (5 or more listings). Very low values can be data errors.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal} = 'All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR COALESCE(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), medians AS (SELECT neighborhood, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) AS median FROM base WHERE deal='sale' AND ppm2>0 AND neighborhood IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 5) SELECT b.title,b.url,b.neighborhood,b.rooms,b.sqm,b.price,b.ppm2,round((100*(b.ppm2/m.median-1))::numeric,0) AS vs_median_pct FROM base b JOIN medians m USING (neighborhood) WHERE b.deal='sale' AND b.ppm2>0 AND b.sqm>=20 ORDER BY b.ppm2/m.median, b.article_id LIMIT 25

panels.title: Recent price cuts
panels.description: Price cuts in the selected time window on active listings, newest first.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal} = 'All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR COALESCE(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)), prices AS (SELECT ph.article_id, ph.price_date, ph.price, lag(ph.price) OVER (PARTITION BY ph.article_id ORDER BY ph.price_date, ph.id) AS previous_price FROM lean.price_history ph JOIN base USING (article_id) WHERE ph.price IS NOT NULL AND ph.source='api_price_history'), cuts AS (SELECT article_id, price_date, previous_price, price, 100.0*(previous_price-price)/previous_price AS cut_pct FROM prices WHERE previous_price > price) SELECT b.title,b.url,c.previous_price AS was,c.price AS now,round(c.cut_pct,1) AS cut_pct,c.price_date,(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - b.first_seen AS days_listed FROM cuts c JOIN base b USING (article_id) WHERE (c.price_date > (${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND c.price_date <= (${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) ORDER BY c.price_date DESC, c.cut_pct DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Longest on market
panels.description: Active listings first seen earliest.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal} = 'All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR COALESCE(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT title,url,price,ppm2,neighborhood,rooms,(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - first_seen AS days_listed,last_seen FROM base ORDER BY first_seen, article_id LIMIT 25

panels.title: Most viewed active listings · per day
panels.description: OLX view count divided by days since the listing was first seen, so new listings are not outranked by old ones.
panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND ((${deal} = 'All' AND l.deal <> 'daily_rent') OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR COALESCE(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (${category} = 'All' OR l.property_type = ${category}) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT title,url,(extra->>'views')::numeric AS views,round((extra->>'views')::numeric / GREATEST((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - first_seen, 1), 1) AS views_per_day,sqm,rooms,price FROM base WHERE extra->>'views' ~ '^[0-9]+$' ORDER BY views_per_day DESC, views DESC LIMIT 25
